JARVIS voice v20

Headphones: JARVIS automatically uses a headphone/headset selected as Windows communications output, otherwise the default media output. Speak naturally without saying Jarvis. Speak again to interrupt a response. This mode has no conversation timeout.
Speakers: say Jarvis followed by a request. Follow-ups last 90 seconds. JARVIS suppresses microphone commands during speaker playback to avoid hearing itself.
The tray JARVIS voice menu shows the listening mode. Listen for Jarvis commands can turn microphone recognition off. Windows microphone settings opens microphone privacy settings; choose your microphone in Windows Sound settings.
British neural George is selected automatically. If unavailable, Windows speech is used and continuous mode is suspended until an output change/restart to avoid speaker echo.
VEYDR is spoken as Vader; the HUD spelling stays unchanged.
Windows speech recognition remains the recognizer. Recognition quality depends on the selected Windows default microphone, microphone volume and background noise. No raw microphone recording is saved by this app.

Basic commands
Close Notepad / Close Chrome (normal close only; save prompts may remain).
Which apps are running?
What's the weather in New York?
What's the weather? (asks for a city if none saved).
Online weather uses Open-Meteo and follows the tray Celsius/Fahrenheit choice. The city is saved in voice settings; ask for weather in another city to change it.
